author: Business Insider
description:
Sponsored by ZS

Business leaders don't want more AI, they want better outcomes. ZS's Aaron Mitchell explains why leaders need to rethink how people and AI agents work together to deliver more.

Mitchell outlines how decision systems can do this: sensing, modeling, deciding, and acting. The biggest shift is acting — a move from using AI to surface insights that inform, to using agents that help make decisions and carry them out. 

Learn more about designing decision systems for better outcomes and how to become an intelligent enterprise: 
https://www.zs.com/capabilities/artificial-intelligence-and-analytics/artificial-intelligence.
